title: Senior Software Engineer (Dapr OSS) – India Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
We believe that open-source software, open standards and APIs are the greatest transformational tools for organizations in the modern software development era.
  
  
Our mission at Diagrid is to provide developers with APIs and tools that help them focus on their code and not on infrastructure. As online digital services need to handle more load and run on multiple clouds or on-premises environments, programming to higher level abstractions delivers consistent, secure and reliable code that is easily portable and helps organizations de-risk their projects.
  
  
Diagrid is founded by the creators of the Dapr and KEDA open-source projects, and who led the user experience, design and development of hyper-scale infrastructure cloud services, serverless platforms and open-source projects at Microsoft. Dapr has now achieved graduated status within the CNCF, joining renowned projects like Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Istio.
  
  
We are backed by top VC firms and supported with industry leading investors and advisors including Joe Beda (Kubernetes Co-Founder, former Co-Founder / CTO at Heptio) Matt Klein (Creator of Envoy, Lyft), Mark Russinovich (CTO, Microsoft Azure), William Morgan (Creator of Linkerd, CEO Buoyant), Seth Vargo (Senior Staff Engineer, Google), Adam Gross (Former CEO, Heroku), Sri Viswanath (Former CTO, Atlassian), Adam Frankl (Dev Marketing Expert, Neo4J & JFrog), and Roopak Venkatakrishnan (Head of platforms, Bolt).
  
  
**About Dapr**
Dapr (Distributed Application Runtime) is a graduated CNCF project that helps developers build distributed, cloud-native applications. It gives them APIs for the hard parts: durable workflows, actors, service invocation, state, pub/sub, scheduled jobs and secure service-to-service communication. Dapr runs in production at companies such as Zeiss, IBM, NASA, Bosch and Lufthansa.
  
  
**About The Role**
You join Diagrid's Runtime team, the engineers who build Dapr and run it inside Diagrid Catalyst. Your work lands in public, in the Dapr open source project, and in the product our customers run in production.
  
  
You will design and ship features in the Dapr runtime, review code from the community and from your team, and help keep releases stable. Much of the current work is in durable execution (Dapr Workflows, actors and the scheduler), where correctness under failure matters more than speed.
  
  
We build with AI every day. We look for engineers who use AI to go further and who check what it produces: you read the diff, you test the failure path, and you own the result, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. In an open source project, reviewing and verifying code matters as much as writing it.
  
  
You are a full member of the team: the same ownership, the same voice in design, and the same chance to grow into a Dapr maintainer as everyone else.
  
  
**Working hours**
Diagrid's team works across Europe and North America.
  
  
Our India team’s day typically starts around 12:00 PM IST, with afternoons overlapping Europe and evenings overlapping the US. You’ll need to be available for a core US overlap window of 8:30 PM to 12:00 AM IST; outside that, you can structure your day flexibly.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and build features in the Dapr runtime, from proposal to release.
* Review pull requests from the community and from your team. Hold the bar on correctness, tests and API design.
* Find and fix bugs in distributed code: race conditions, retries, partial failures, and state that must survive a crash.
* Write proposals and design docs in public, and respond to review on them.
* Take part in Dapr releases: release candidates, patch releases and security fixes.
* Help users and contributors on GitHub and Discord, and mentor new contributors.

**What We Look For**

* 5+ years of professional Go, with production code you can explain line by line.
* Experience designing and running distributed systems. You know how they fail, and you design for it.
* 2+ years with Kubernetes and containers.
* A strong computer science base: concurrency, networking and data consistency.
* Daily, practical use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to check their output before you ship it.
* Clear written English. Most of our work happens in GitHub issues, pull requests and design docs, read by people across many companies and time zones.

**Leading in India**
You’ll be our first engineer in India, and you’ll help build the team that follows. Engineers who join in India will report to technical managers on their own teams, with a dotted line to you. Their managers own their day-to-day work and performance; you’re their local lead and point of contact.
  
  

* Help hire the India team: shape the hiring process, interview candidates and help us find the right people.
* Onboard new engineers and help them become productive in Dapr, our codebase and how we work.
* Be the go-to person in India for questions, feedback and support, and raise issues to their managers when needed.
* Build a strong engineering culture in India that matches how we work across Diagrid: ownership, quality and working in the open.
* Work with leadership on India-specific topics such as hiring plans, working hours and team setup.
* Represent Diagrid in the local engineering and open source community, through meetups, conferences and contributor outreach.

This role stays hands-on. Most of your time goes to engineering work on the runtime, and the leadership side grows as the team does.
  
  
**Bonus**

* Merged contributions to open source Go projects, especially CNCF projects.
* Experience as a maintainer of an open source project.
* Experience with Dapr, or with workflow and durable execution engines (Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, AWS Step Functions).
* gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
* One of the other languages Dapr has SDKs for: Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET or Rust.

**Diagrid Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Company equity
* Remote first & flexible work environment
* Flexible paid time off
* Comprehensive healthcare for you and your dependents
* Choice of hardware
* $1000 for home office setup
* Monthly WFH stipend
* Team events & gatherings
* Chance to collaborate with industry-leading figures

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

title: AI Solutions & Automation Engineer
description:
**About The Company**
If you have ever watched television or enjoyed a movie on your phone or tablet, this experience was likely brought to you through an Ateme solution created by our award-winning engineering teams.
  
  
Ateme (PARIS: ATEME) is the global leader in video delivery, partnering with top content and service providers, and streaming platforms like Netflix.
  
  
Through our cutting-edge R&D and innovation, we enable clients to deliver high-quality video experiences on any device, boosting engagement and revenue.
  
  
Guided by a robust CSR policy, we are committed to making the entertainment and video experience captivating, greener, accessible to everyone, while promoting our employees’ well-being and ethical business practices.
  
  
At Ateme, we prioritize innovation, collaboration, empowerment, agility, and diverse contributions.
  
  
**Join us and help shape the future of video delivery!**
Ateme is looking for a
**permanent AI Solutions & Automation Engineer**
to design, develop, and deploy internal tools that reduce repetitive tasks, streamline access to information, and improve team efficiency, particularly across Sales, Pre-Sales, Support, Product, and Operations.
  
  
Your role will sit at the intersection of full-stack development, generative AI, automation, and business understanding. You will work from real business needs to develop reliable, measurable solutions that are easy for teams to adopt.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and prioritize use cases: Work directly with business teams to understand their processes, identify low-value or repetitive tasks, and define the expected benefits.
* Prototype quickly: Design proofs of concept and usage-focused MVPs, test them with users, and iterate based on feedback.
* Develop end-to-end internal tools: Build user interfaces, backend services, workflows, agents, and integrations through to operational deployment.
* Connect enterprise systems: Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and other approved data sources while respecting access rights and permissions.
* Industrialize solutions: Implement testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, version management, support, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure security and responsible AI: Apply data protection, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight, and risk management requirements.
* Measure impact: Define adoption, quality, and operational efficiency metrics with business teams and track the value delivered after deployment.
* Build reusable solutions: Document components and agents, avoid duplication, and contribute to a shared architecture that enables solutions to be reused across multiple teams.

**Examples of Solutions you may build**

* Assistants for meeting preparation, meeting summaries, and action tracking.
* Intelligent search across commercial and technical documentation.
* Automation of RFP responses and generation of scoping documents.
* Tools to support proposal preparation, opportunity tracking, and consolidation of information from multiple sources.
* Support agents capable of suggesting contextualized resolutions and enriching the knowledge base.
* Simple internal applications to automate checks, calculations, reporting, and recurring workflows.

**Required Skills and Experience**
You hold a Master’s degree (Bac+5), engineering degree, or equivalent qualification, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in application development, automation, or the implementation of AI solutions in an enterprise environment.
  
  

* Full-stack development: Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, web applications, databases, and user-focused interface design.
* Generative AI and agents: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, and response quality evaluation.
* Integration: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SSO, enterprise APIs and connectors, identity and permission management.
* Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment on cloud or internal platforms.
* Product thinking: Ability to start from a business need, define an MVP, balance simplicity and robustness, and support user adoption.
* Security & governance: Good practices in data protection, secrets management, auditability, human oversight, and documentation.

**Additionall Skills that would be an advantage**

* Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI, or Azure OpenAI.
* Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Dataverse, or Fabric.
* Agent interoperability protocols and standards, particularly MCP.
* Experience in media, video, B2B SaaS, or enterprise software environments.
* UX practices, change management, and user training.

**How your work matters**
Curiosity, pragmatism, autonomy, and a results-oriented mindset are essential. You enjoy understanding how people actually work, simplifying complex problems, and delivering useful solutions.
  
  
You can clearly explain your decisions, collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, experiment quickly without compromising security, and understand that a solution only creates value when people actually use it.
  
  
**Location**
We consider different locations in Europe and Asia (our offices locations) but we do not consider 100% remote. This job is not eligible for mobility or relocation opportunities.
  
  
At Ateme,
**onboarding**
is much more than a process. It is a complete experience designed to set you up for success: immersive training, regular meetings with your manager and HR, a collaborative culture, and stimulating projects.
  
  
Join us for a rewarding professional journey where your development and success matter.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**

* Compensation based on experience
* Hybrid working model
* Bonuses: performance bonus, employee referral bonus, etc.
* Access to our internal training platform, including video technologies, Kubernetes, AWS, and more
* International collaboration with Business, IT, Product, R&D, and Security teams

To learn more about Ateme, visit our corporate website:
  
  
**www.ateme.com**

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..

title: Security and Threat Operations Engineer
description:
**About OnePay**
OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.
  
  
Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.
  
  
We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.
  
  
We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.
  
  
But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are
  
  

* Ready to run
* Hungry and driven by urgency
* Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
* Comfortable operating in motion

The Role
  
  
As a Security And Threat Operations Engineer At OnePay, Your Work Will Have a Direct Impact On Protecting Our Fast-moving Fintech Environment. You Will Turn Production Signals Into Actionable Detection, Response, And Hardening Initiatives, Partnering Closely With Product Security, Platform Security, And Engineering Teams. Your Efforts Will Enable Us To Proactively Identify, Monitor, And Stop Compromised Behaviors Across OnePay's Products And Infrastructure, Ensuring The Continued Safety And Trust Of Our Business And Customers. You Will
  
  

* Build and tune detections, alerts, and monitoring workflows across cloud, application, identity, and edge environments.
* Review traffic patterns across APIs, authentication flows, and WAF telemetry to identify malicious activity, abuse patterns, and anomalous behavior.
* Use AI responsibly as a force multiplier for triage, analysis, and workflow automation, while helping define guardrails for AI-enabled systems.
* Help operate OnePay's vulnerability management program by triaging, prioritizing, and driving remediation for findings from Wiz, vulnerability scanning, and related workflows.
* Develop Python-based tooling and automation to improve investigations, enrichment, response, and operational scale.
* Partner with Product Security to translate threat models, security reviews, and product risks into production detections and response playbooks.
* Investigate security events end to end, including triage, scoping, containment support, and follow-through on remediation.
* Support vulnerability management and operational security practices in ways that align with PCI and SOC 2 expectations.
* Participate in proactive threat hunting, detection improvement, and a 24x7 security incident response on-call rotation.

Tools We Use
  
  
We use Node and TypeScript on the server, leveraging the NestJS framework within a microservice-oriented architecture running on Kubernetes and AWS. On the client side, we build and ship product features for iOS, Android, and web platforms using React Native. We also embrace AI-assisted development, so engineers have their choice of Claude Code or Cursor to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.
  
  
You Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in information security, threat detection, security operations, detection engineering, or incident response, ideally in a cloud-native or product-focused environment.
* Strong experience investigating suspicious activity in web, API, authentication, and infrastructure telemetry, with the ability to distinguish attacker behavior from normal production noise.
* Demonstrated ability to review traffic and event patterns for signs of malicious activity, fraud, account abuse, credential attacks, reconnaissance, and exploitation attempts.
* Strong Python programming skills and the ability to write maintainable code for automation, enrichment, analysis, and security operations tooling.
* Experience building and tuning detections in a SIEM or detection platform and working with observability and logging systems such as CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar platforms.
* Experience operating or supporting a vulnerability management program, including triage, prioritization, remediation tracking, and stakeholder coordination.
* Familiarity with cloud and application security findings from platforms such as Wiz, including CNAPP, runtime, code, and vulnerability scanning use cases.
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS.
* Working knowledge of identity and access systems, modern authentication flows, and the security implications of internet-facing applications and APIs.
* Strong understanding of threat modeling, risk prioritization, and practical security controls across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
* Practical experience using AI tools in security workflows, along with sound judgment about AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive tool access, and weak auditability.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, especially in environments where security needs to move quickly with product and engineering teams.
* Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
* Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
* Monthly transport and work-from-home allowances
* A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process
  
  
**Our Process Varies By Role. Most Candidates Go Through**

* AI-assisted initial screen
* Interview with Talent Partner
* Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Executive Interview
* Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

title: Senior Manager, Engineering(Platform)
description:
**About Stord**
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
  
  
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
  
  
With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
  
  
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.
  
  
Stord is building the operating system for modern supply chain: a unified platform handling Order Management, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and Consumer Experience for brands doing billions in commerce annually.
  
  
The Platform team sits underneath all of it. The shared services, tooling, and standards Platform owns are what every product team builds on, which means the quality of Platform's work shows up in OMS, WMS, TMS, Commerce, and AI. Stord is in a growth stage, and many of the hard problems that come with it land here. This role leads a single team of about five engineers, expected to expand to multiple teams as scope grows, and also serves as the product lead for Platform. You are the voice of the team to every product engineering group, and you lead the effort to get what Platform builds adopted, working alongside product engineering leaders.
  
  
This role is for a strong engineer who is also a great leader. You were a high-performing IC, you still know what good engineering looks like, and you spend your days close to your engineers and your stakeholders. You can tell when a plan has a hole in it and say so plainly. You get your results through other people and are comfortable never writing the code yourself. You are also a credible advocate who can explain what Platform is building and why to engineers and executives alike, and who earns adoption by listening to customers(other Engineering teams). If you want to shape how an entire tech stack scales and build the team that does it, this role was built for you.
  
  
Why This Role
  
  

* Platform sits at the center of every product team, so how well your team executes is visible across the whole stack.
* You are the face of Platform and lead the push to get what you build adopted, in partnership with product engineering leaders.
* Stord is in a growth stage, and Platform is where many of the problems that make that growth sustainable get solved.
* You start with one team of about five engineers and have a real path to leading several as the scope grows.
* Solving for real scale is part of the job, and the decisions you make will have to hold up as volume and complexity climb.
* You work daily with engineers and with leaders across every product area, so your input shapes priorities across the company.
* The stack is multifaceted, with Elixir and TypeScript as the primary languages.

**What You'll Do**
**Team Leadership & Delivery**

* Own the complete people management lifecycle for the Platform team, starting with about five engineers and growing from there.
* Stay close to the work. Know what each engineer is building day to day, read the designs and pull requests that matter, and ask the questions that surface gaps early.
* Challenge plans and viewpoints directly when they don't hold up, and push the team toward a better answer.
* Run planning, standups, and retrospectives that keep the team predictable and moving fast.
* Report delivery, quality, risk, and resourcing to engineering leadership on a regular cadence, using measures that keep observations as objective as possible.

**Platform Product Leadership & Adoption**

* Act as the product lead for Platform. Define what the team builds, for whom, and why, and own the roadmap as a product.
* Be the voice of Platform across Engineering. Communicate what is shipping, what is coming, and how to use it to product engineering teams and leadership.
* Lead adoption of Platform products and features in partnership with product engineering leaders. Set adoption goals, track them, and report on progress.
* Treat product engineering teams as your customers. Gather feedback regularly, find where they get stuck, and feed it back into the roadmap.
* Drive the documentation, migration paths, and enablement material that make adoption easy.
* Make the case for retiring legacy approaches, and push teams to move when the Platform path is the better one.
* Define success measures for Platform products, such as adoption, reliability, and developer experience, and report on them to leadership.

**People Development & Hiring**

* Run weekly 1:1s focused on growth, feedback, and career development.
* Deliver performance reviews, make compensation recommendations, and write promotion cases for your direct reports.
* Handle performance issues and hard conversations directly, including the cases where an engineer needs to move on.
* Lead the full hiring lifecycle, and sell both the role and Stord to candidates with credible optimism about where the company is today.
* Identify and develop future tech leads and managers as Platform expands to multiple teams.

**Technical & Roadmap Ownership**

* Own the Platform roadmap and architectural direction across multiple quarters, working with your tech lead and principal engineers.
* Turn the needs of product teams into prioritized platform work, and sequence it against competing demands.
* Hold quality and velocity together. Set the standards for code review, testing, and release practices that let the team ship fast without regressions.
* Hold your team accountable for AI adoption, and replace or significantly improve legacy team processes through AI enablement.
* Manage team cost drivers such as tooling, infrastructure, and contractor spend, and flag budget risk early.

**Cross-Team Alignment & Platform Reliability**

* Work daily with engineering managers, product leaders, and stakeholders across Product Engineering.
* Own the reliability of the platform services your team runs: monitoring, incident response, root cause follow-through, and on-call discipline.
* Represent Platform in cross-team planning, keep dependencies visible, and drive consistent engineering practices across teams.
* Renegotiate scope and priorities when demand exceeds capacity.

**Required**
**What We're Looking For**

* Engineering management (3+ years): You have led teams of 5+ engineers with a track record of predictable delivery and team development, and you have managed through ambiguity.
* Strong engineering background (5+ years as a high-performing IC): You were a strong engineer first. You can read a design or a pull request, reason about it, and challenge it. You do not carry sprint work yourself.
* Product ownership of a technical platform: You have owned the roadmap of a platform, tooling, or shared service used by other engineering teams, and have helped those teams adopt it. You can define customers, set priorities, and measure adoption.
* Distributed systems and service architecture depth: You can evaluate trade-offs in reliability, scalability, and system design well enough to pressure-test your team's decisions.
* Hard conversations and performance management: You have first-hand experience with underperformance, conflict, and difficult exits, and you handled them directly.
* Full hiring lifecycle: You have sourced, interviewed, closed, and onboarded engineers, and you can sell yourself and Stord to a strong candidate.
* A way to measure your team: You have a repeatable process for assessing team and individual performance with as little subjectivity as possible.
* Strong opinions, held with evidence: You are a decision maker. You take a position, defend it with facts, and change it when the facts change.

**Required Soft Skills**

* Ownership & Accountability: You own outcomes, not just activities. When your team ships, you take pride. When something breaks, you take responsibility and fix the system.
* Strong Communication: You communicate clearly with engineers, PMs, and executives. You translate technical complexity into business language and vice versa.
* Delegation & Multiplication: You scale through people, not heroics. You have a history of developing team members and multiplying impact through others.
* Navigating Ambiguity: You set direction when requirements are evolving. You build alignment across teams and functions without formal authority.
* Balanced Judgment: You balance innovation with pragmatic delivery constraints. You know when to push for quality and when to ship.
* Directed AI-Assisted Development: You understand how AI coding tools work as a productivity multiplier and can guide your team's adoption while maintaining quality and independent technical judgment.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience driving adoption of internal platforms or developer tooling across multiple engineering teams.
* Production experience with Elixir or TypeScript, and the appetite to get fluent in both.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, or shared-services teams whose customers are other engineering teams.
* A track record of scaling a team across multiple teams through rising scale and scope without a drop in delivery quality.
* Experience operating systems through significant growth in load, usage, or complexity.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event-driven architecture.
* Experience leading incident response and post-incident improvement across multiple teams.
* Experience introducing AI-enabled workflows that changed how an engineering team operates.

**What Success Looks Like**

* 30 days: You have met with every engineer on the team and with the leaders of each product engineering team. You understand Platform's current roadmap, delivery cadence, and risks, how teams use Platform today, and you have a point of view on what needs to change.
* 90 days: You own the team's delivery rhythm, your 1:1s are producing real development conversations, and product teams trust your status updates and priorities. You have published a Platform roadmap, defined adoption measures, and begun reporting on them.
* 6 months: The team ships predictably, and quality and velocity trends are visible and improving. Adoption of key Platform capabilities is rising across product engineering teams, and they see Platform as a partner. You have made a meaningful hire or development move, and you have a plan for expanding to multiple teams.
